$comment: What each --ai-* CSS variable is for. Naming rules live in conventions.json. scripts/component-manifest.mjs fails when a stylesheet reads a variable that is not listed here, or when one listed here is no longer read. Theme colours take their light and dark values from defaultTheme; set theme variables through AITheme or themeToCSS, and the rest directly on a wrapper.

--ai-surface-subtle.purpose: Quiet fills: hover rows, code, chips, user bubbles.

--ai-muted.purpose: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, placeholders.

--ai-control-border.purpose: Outlines of inputs, selects and checkboxes; 3:1 against the surface.

--ai-primary.purpose: Primary buttons and the strongest emphasis.

--ai-primary-foreground.purpose: Text and icons on a primary fill.

--ai-primary-soft.purpose: Selected and active fills: chosen chips, current rows.

--ai-primary-text.purpose: Primary-coloured text, readable on the surface and on the soft fill.

--ai-accent.purpose: Accent fill for highlights such as the Persona orb.

--ai-success.purpose: Success text and icons: Complete, Passed, Connected.

--ai-warning.purpose: Warning text: Needs review, Unconfirmed, Cannot be undone.

--ai-danger-soft.purpose: Error badge fill and removed diff lines.

--ai-focus.purpose: Keyboard focus rings; 3:1 against the surfaces.

--ai-radius.purpose: Corners of panels, menus and dialogs.

--ai-button-radius.purpose: Corners of buttons; follows the control radius unless set.

--ai-radius-card.purpose: Corners of Card and Stat surfaces.

--ai-radius-pill.purpose: Corners of chips and segmented controls.

--ai-field-background.purpose: Fill of text fields: the surface, or the subtle surface when fields are tinted.

--ai-shadow-popover.purpose: Shadow under menus, popovers and floating buttons.

--ai-shadow-panel.purpose: Optional shadow on raised panels; none unless a host sets it.

--ai-control-height.purpose: Height of buttons, inputs and menu rows; 32px when compact.

--ai-gap.purpose: Space between blocks inside a component.

--ai-field-gap.purpose: Space between a label, its control and its help text.

--ai-panel-padding.purpose: Inner padding of panels and cards.

--ai-row-gap.purpose: Space between rows in page-level layouts.

--ai-activity-gap.purpose: Space between lines of an assistant's activity (tool calls, reasoning).

--ai-matrix-flip.purpose: Matrix fill level at which cell text switches to the primary foreground; computed by the theme.

--ai-font-family.purpose: Interface typeface; inherits the page font when unset.

--ai-font-mono.purpose: Monospace typeface for code, paths and identifiers.

--ai-font-numeric.purpose: Typeface for figures: Stat values, durations, counts and deltas; the monospace face when unset.

--ai-font-size.purpose: Body text size of the interface.

--ai-font-size-message.purpose: Conversation text in the chat message variant, as in ChatGPT.

--ai-duration-fast.purpose: Short transitions: hover, open and close.

--ai-chat-height.purpose: Height of Chat; set 100% to fill a parent.

--ai-message-padding.purpose: Inner padding of the panel message variant.

--ai-launcher-z.purpose: Stacking level of the ChatLauncher bubble and panel.

--ai-list-inset.purpose: Left inset of compact ThreadList rows and labels, to line up with a host's navigation.

--ai-navigation-height.purpose: Maximum height of the ThreadList scroll area; none lets it grow.

--ai-navigation-gutter.purpose: Scrollbar room of the ThreadList; auto when the list grows inside another scroller.

--ai-workspace-navigation-width.purpose: Width of the WorkspaceShell navigation pane.

--ai-workspace-inspector-width.purpose: Width of the WorkspaceShell inspector pane.

--ai-workspace-pane-padding.purpose: Inner padding of scrolling WorkspaceShell panes; 0 when their content scrolls itself.

--ai-workspace-pane-gutter.purpose: Scrollbar room of WorkspaceShell panes; auto when their content scrolls itself.

--ai-waterfall-figures.purpose: Width of the figures column (duration, tokens, cost) in the ExecutionTimeline waterfall; 300px by default.

--ai-sidecar-inset.purpose: Distance of the Sidecar from the viewport edge.

--ai-sidecar-inset-top.purpose: Top offset of the Sidecar, below a fixed header.

--ai-sidecar-sheet-height.purpose: Height of the Sidecar as a bottom sheet on small screens.

--ai-matrix-header-height.purpose: Height of the Matrix column header row.

--ai-matrix-end-padding.purpose: Space after the last Matrix column.

--ai-matrix-max-level.purpose: Highest Matrix level, for the fill scale.

--ai-dot-ring-size.purpose: Width and height of the DotRing figure.

--ai-heat-key-size.purpose: Width and height of a HeatKeys cell.

--ai-tone-pad-width.purpose: Width of the TonePad, including its axis labels.
